narrative.overview: Shared white operating surfaces for local editing, pin management, opt-in history and independent board. Frozen blur remains on capture bars. Icon rows and contextual annotation modes, Windows native captions, seven settings sections. Non-destructive pin transforms, board geometry, backdrop preview and per-user MSI are validated with synthetic/hidden controls and isolated installation only; desktop GUI NOT RUN.
